TEXT.English: Election result
TEXT.French: Election result
TEXT.German: Wahlergebnis
TEXT.Italian: Election result
TEXT.Spanish: Election result

TEXT.English: Adopt %s1_civic
TEXT.French: Adopt %s1_civic
TEXT.German: %s1_civic annehmen
TEXT.Italian: Adopt %s1_civic
TEXT.Spanish: Adopt %s1_civic

TEXT.English: The electorate has sought guidance from its ancestors. Their silence has been interpreted as unanimous approval.
TEXT.French: The electorate has sought guidance from its ancestors. Their silence has been interpreted as unanimous approval.
TEXT.German: Die Wähler haben ihre Ahnen um Rat gefragt. Deren Schweigen wurde als einstimmige Zustimmung gewertet.
TEXT.Italian: The electorate has sought guidance from its ancestors. Their silence has been interpreted as unanimous approval.
TEXT.Spanish: The electorate has sought guidance from its ancestors. Their silence has been interpreted as unanimous approval.

TEXT.English: The voters demand a larger army. Recruitment officials are delighted to explain that the voters themselves constitute the larger army.
TEXT.French: The voters demand a larger army. Recruitment officials are delighted to explain that the voters themselves constitute the larger army.
TEXT.German: Die Wähler verlangen ein größeres Heer. Die Rekrutierungsbeamten erklären erfreut, dass die Wähler selbst dieses größere Heer bilden.
TEXT.Italian: The voters demand a larger army. Recruitment officials are delighted to explain that the voters themselves constitute the larger army.
TEXT.Spanish: The voters demand a larger army. Recruitment officials are delighted to explain that the voters themselves constitute the larger army.

TEXT.English: The electorate has chosen enterprise and competition. Several companies immediately offered to sponsor the announcement.
TEXT.French: The electorate has chosen enterprise and competition. Several companies immediately offered to sponsor the announcement.
TEXT.German: Die Wähler haben Unternehmergeist und Wettbewerb gewählt. Mehrere Firmen haben sofort angeboten, die Bekanntmachung zu sponsern.
TEXT.Italian: The electorate has chosen enterprise and competition. Several companies immediately offered to sponsor the announcement.
TEXT.Spanish: The electorate has chosen enterprise and competition. Several companies immediately offered to sponsor the announcement.

TEXT.English: The electorate has entrusted its freedom to one exceptionally trustworthy individual. Further elections may confirm this assessment.
TEXT.French: The electorate has entrusted its freedom to one exceptionally trustworthy individual. Further elections may confirm this assessment.
TEXT.German: Die Wähler haben ihre Freiheit einem außergewöhnlich vertrauenswürdigen Einzelnen anvertraut. Weitere Wahlen werden dies womöglich bestätigen.
TEXT.Italian: The electorate has entrusted its freedom to one exceptionally trustworthy individual. Further elections may confirm this assessment.
TEXT.Spanish: The electorate has entrusted its freedom to one exceptionally trustworthy individual. Further elections may confirm this assessment.

TEXT.English: The voters have chosen a holy mission for the nation. The distinction between cabinet meetings and religious services is becoming ceremonial.
TEXT.French: The voters have chosen a holy mission for the nation. The distinction between cabinet meetings and religious services is becoming ceremonial.
TEXT.German: Die Wähler haben eine heilige Mission für die Nation gewählt. Der Unterschied zwischen Kabinettssitzung und Gottesdienst wird zunehmend zeremoniell.
TEXT.Italian: The voters have chosen a holy mission for the nation. The distinction between cabinet meetings and religious services is becoming ceremonial.
TEXT.Spanish: The voters have chosen a holy mission for the nation. The distinction between cabinet meetings and religious services is becoming ceremonial.

TEXT.English: The electorate has demanded knights, honor, and magnificent horses. The treasury has asked whether ordinary horses would suffice.
TEXT.French: The electorate has demanded knights, honor, and magnificent horses. The treasury has asked whether ordinary horses would suffice.
TEXT.German: Die Wähler verlangen Ritter, Ehre und prächtige Pferde. Die Staatskasse fragt, ob gewöhnliche Pferde auch genügen würden.
TEXT.Italian: The electorate has demanded knights, honor, and magnificent horses. The treasury has asked whether ordinary horses would suffice.
TEXT.Spanish: The electorate has demanded knights, honor, and magnificent horses. The treasury has asked whether ordinary horses would suffice.

TEXT.English: The people have voted to defend their homes personally. Training begins after the harvest; everyone should bring something pointy.
TEXT.French: The people have voted to defend their homes personally. Training begins after the harvest; everyone should bring something pointy.
TEXT.German: Das Volk will seine Häuser persönlich verteidigen. Die Ausbildung beginnt nach der Ernte; jeder bringe etwas Spitzes mit.
TEXT.Italian: The people have voted to defend their homes personally. Training begins after the harvest; everyone should bring something pointy.
TEXT.Spanish: The people have voted to defend their homes personally. Training begins after the harvest; everyone should bring something pointy.

TEXT.English: The nation has voted to put the nation first. Other nations are invited to admire the decision from a respectful distance.
TEXT.French: The nation has voted to put the nation first. Other nations are invited to admire the decision from a respectful distance.
TEXT.German: Die Nation hat entschieden, die Nation an erste Stelle zu setzen. Andere Nationen dürfen diese Entscheidung aus respektvollem Abstand bewundern.
TEXT.Italian: The nation has voted to put the nation first. Other nations are invited to admire the decision from a respectful distance.
TEXT.Spanish: The nation has voted to put the nation first. Other nations are invited to admire the decision from a respectful distance.

TEXT.English: The people have approved the Five-Year Plan. Production targets are ambitious; the supply of celebratory posters is already exceeding expectations.
TEXT.French: The people have approved the Five-Year Plan. Production targets are ambitious; the supply of celebratory posters is already exceeding expectations.
TEXT.German: Das Volk hat den Fünfjahresplan gebilligt. Die Produktionsziele sind ehrgeizig; bei Jubelplakaten wird der Plan bereits übererfüllt.
TEXT.Italian: The people have approved the Five-Year Plan. Production targets are ambitious; the supply of celebratory posters is already exceeding expectations.
TEXT.Spanish: The people have approved the Five-Year Plan. Production targets are ambitious; the supply of celebratory posters is already exceeding expectations.

TEXT.English: Every citizen had a voice. Some citizens also had a printing press, three banks, and the candidates’ home addresses.
TEXT.French: Every citizen had a voice. Some citizens also had a printing press, three banks, and the candidates’ home addresses.
TEXT.German: Jeder Bürger hatte eine Stimme. Einige besaßen außerdem eine Druckerei, drei Banken und die Privatadressen der Kandidaten.
TEXT.Italian: Every citizen had a voice. Some citizens also had a printing press, three banks, and the candidates’ home addresses.
TEXT.Spanish: Every citizen had a voice. Some citizens also had a printing press, three banks, and the candidates’ home addresses.

TEXT.English: National defense will be entrusted to trained professionals. The public is relieved; the payroll department is less enthusiastic.
TEXT.French: National defense will be entrusted to trained professionals. The public is relieved; the payroll department is less enthusiastic.
TEXT.German: Die Landesverteidigung wird ausgebildeten Profis anvertraut. Die Bevölkerung ist erleichtert; die Besoldungsstelle zeigt weniger Begeisterung.
TEXT.Italian: National defense will be entrusted to trained professionals. The public is relieved; the payroll department is less enthusiastic.
TEXT.Spanish: National defense will be entrusted to trained professionals. The public is relieved; the payroll department is less enthusiastic.

TEXT.English: The people demand equal treatment before the law. A committee will now determine precisely how many forms this requires.
TEXT.French: The people demand equal treatment before the law. A committee will now determine precisely how many forms this requires.
TEXT.German: Das Volk verlangt Gleichheit vor dem Gesetz. Ein Ausschuss wird nun ermitteln, wie viele Formulare dafür erforderlich sind.
TEXT.Italian: The people demand equal treatment before the law. A committee will now determine precisely how many forms this requires.
TEXT.Spanish: The people demand equal treatment before the law. A committee will now determine precisely how many forms this requires.

TEXT.English: The voters have rejected economic complexity. Everyone will grow their own dinner; the economists have been issued hoes.
TEXT.French: The voters have rejected economic complexity. Everyone will grow their own dinner; the economists have been issued hoes.
TEXT.German: Die Wähler haben wirtschaftliche Komplexität abgelehnt. Jeder baut sein eigenes Abendessen an; die Ökonomen haben Hacken erhalten.
TEXT.Italian: The voters have rejected economic complexity. Everyone will grow their own dinner; the economists have been issued hoes.
TEXT.Spanish: The voters have rejected economic complexity. Everyone will grow their own dinner; the economists have been issued hoes.

TEXT.English: The countryside has voted for stability. To prevent unnecessary movement, the winning party has attached the voters to the countryside.
TEXT.French: The countryside has voted for stability. To prevent unnecessary movement, the winning party has attached the voters to the countryside.
TEXT.German: Das Land hat für Beständigkeit gestimmt. Um unnötige Bewegung zu verhindern, hat die Siegerpartei die Wähler an das Land gebunden.
TEXT.Italian: The countryside has voted for stability. To prevent unnecessary movement, the winning party has attached the voters to the countryside.
TEXT.Spanish: The countryside has voted for stability. To prevent unnecessary movement, the winning party has attached the voters to the countryside.

TEXT.English: The electorate has voted for cheaper labor. The people expected to provide it were conspicuously absent from the electoral register.
TEXT.French: The electorate has voted for cheaper labor. The people expected to provide it were conspicuously absent from the electoral register.
TEXT.German: Die Wähler haben sich für billigere Arbeitskräfte entschieden. Die dafür vorgesehenen Menschen fehlten auffällig im Wählerverzeichnis.
TEXT.Italian: The electorate has voted for cheaper labor. The people expected to provide it were conspicuously absent from the electoral register.
TEXT.Spanish: The electorate has voted for cheaper labor. The people expected to provide it were conspicuously absent from the electoral register.

TEXT.English: The people have voted to separate religion from public life. The government intends to accomplish this with considerable enthusiasm.
TEXT.French: The people have voted to separate religion from public life. The government intends to accomplish this with considerable enthusiasm.
TEXT.German: Das Volk will Religion vom öffentlichen Leben trennen. Die Regierung beabsichtigt, dies mit beträchtlichem Eifer umzusetzen.
TEXT.Italian: The people have voted to separate religion from public life. The government intends to accomplish this with considerable enthusiasm.
TEXT.Spanish: The people have voted to separate religion from public life. The government intends to accomplish this with considerable enthusiasm.

TEXT.English: The nation has elected an official faith. The government assures everyone that this will simplify matters considerably.
TEXT.French: The nation has elected an official faith. The government assures everyone that this will simplify matters considerably.
TEXT.German: Die Nation hat einen amtlichen Glauben gewählt. Die Regierung versichert, dass dies alles erheblich vereinfachen wird.
TEXT.Italian: The nation has elected an official faith. The government assures everyone that this will simplify matters considerably.
TEXT.Spanish: The nation has elected an official faith. The government assures everyone that this will simplify matters considerably.

TEXT.English: The election results have been certified by the highest authority. Requests for a recount should be submitted through prayer.
TEXT.French: The election results have been certified by the highest authority. Requests for a recount should be submitted through prayer.
TEXT.German: Das Wahlergebnis wurde von höchster Stelle bestätigt. Anträge auf Neuauszählung sind als Gebet einzureichen.
TEXT.Italian: The election results have been certified by the highest authority. Requests for a recount should be submitted through prayer.
TEXT.Spanish: The election results have been certified by the highest authority. Requests for a recount should be submitted through prayer.

TEXT.English: The electorate has agreed that everyone may worship as they please. Agreement on anything else remains entirely optional.
TEXT.French: The electorate has agreed that everyone may worship as they please. Agreement on anything else remains entirely optional.
TEXT.German: Die Wähler sind sich einig, dass jeder glauben darf, was er möchte. Einigkeit in allen anderen Fragen bleibt freiwillig.
TEXT.Italian: The electorate has agreed that everyone may worship as they please. Agreement on anything else remains entirely optional.
TEXT.Spanish: The electorate has agreed that everyone may worship as they please. Agreement on anything else remains entirely optional.

TEXT.English: The voters demand a return to traditional values: courage, strength, and settling policy disagreements with a club.
TEXT.French: The voters demand a return to traditional values: courage, strength, and settling policy disagreements with a club.
TEXT.German: Die Wähler verlangen traditionelle Werte: Mut, Stärke und die Klärung politischer Meinungsverschiedenheiten mit einer Keule.
TEXT.Italian: The voters demand a return to traditional values: courage, strength, and settling policy disagreements with a club.
TEXT.Spanish: The voters demand a return to traditional values: courage, strength, and settling policy disagreements with a club.
